name: Propranolol
summary: The drug is a nonselective beta blocker. It is used in medication for high blood pressure, anxiety, and tremors.

pharmacology.text: Propranolol is classified as a competitive non-cardioselective sympatholytic beta blocker. It is lipid soluble and also has sodium channel-blocking effects. Propranolol is a non-selective β-adrenergic receptor antagonist, or beta blocker; that is, it blocks the action of epinephrine (adrenaline) and norepinephrine (noradrenaline) at both β1- and β2-adrenergic receptors.

body.says: Liver (extensive) CYP1A2, CYP2D6; minor: CYP2C19, CYP3A4; aromatic hydroxylation (mainly 4-hydroxylation), N-dealkylation, side-chain oxidation, glucuronidation

uses.text: Propranolol is indicated for the treatment of hypertension (high blood pressure). angina pectoris, atrial fibrillation, myocardial infarction, migraine, essential tremor, hypertrophic subaortic stenosis, and pheochromocytoma (catecholamine-secreting tumors).

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include nausea, abdominal pain, and constipation.

summaryZh: 普萘洛爾是一種β受體阻滯劑類藥物。它用於治療高血壓、某些類型的心律不整、甲狀腺功能亢進症、微血管血管瘤、靜坐不能、表演焦慮症和原發性震顫，以及用於預防偏頭痛，並防止患有心絞痛或曾有心肌梗塞的個體出現進一步的心臟問題。
summaryZhHans: 普萘洛尔是一种β受体阻滞剂类药物。它用于治疗高血压、某些类型的心律不整、甲状腺功能亢进症、微血管血管瘤、静坐不能、表演焦虑症和原发性震颤，以及用于预防偏头痛，并防止患有心绞痛或曾有心肌梗塞的个体出现进一步的心脏问题。

fact.en: Propranolol was developed in the early 1960s by the Scottish pharmacologist James Black at ICI. It was the first widely successful beta blocker, and Black shared the 1988 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine partly for this work.
fact.zh: 普萘洛爾由蘇格蘭藥理學家 James Black 於 1960 年代初期在 ICI 公司開發。它是第一個廣泛成功的乙型阻斷劑，Black 也部分因為這項成果獲得 1988 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。
fact.zhHans: 普萘洛尔由苏格兰药理学家 James Black 于 1960 年代初期在 ICI 公司开发。它是第一个广泛成功的乙型阻断剂，Black 也部分因为这项成果获得 1988 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
